verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms polar.sh/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content. The docs claim llms.txt at polar.sh/docs with `.md` siblings for every page, and many `.md` doc URLs are cited throughout the pack. The docs site also serves versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs. The 404s at /docs.md and root OpenAPI paths are only unguessed candidate paths and do not contradict the documented locations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming the docs effectively, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated full-text variant.
